status: Strict master-preservation experiment; not integrated into live game

jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: attached approved Finn master PNG. This is animation frame F01, a tiny in-place facial edit of this exact artwork, NOT a redraw, character design, enlargement, restaging, or sprite sheet.
Change ONLY the eye lids: close BOTH eyes for a natural blink. Keep eyebrow shape unchanged. The closed eye lines must be where the original eyes are, same face proportions, with a gentle eyelid arc.
Mandatory invariants: reproduce the input canvas and figure at EXACTLY the same size, position and scale. Copy the hair, skull, ears, nose, mouth, jaw, neck, shirt, tie, shoulders, hands, gold 100 card backs, trousers, knees, socks and shoes unchanged. No other pixel-region should change. Do not improve or stylize any detail. No growing head, rounding the face, broadening shoulders or recentering.
Canvas: 2048 by 2048 transparent PNG, original full-body seated-looking chair-free figure centered in original middle half of canvas, original approximately 512px transparent clearance above head and below feet. Preserve all generous empty transparent space. Do not zoom to fill the canvas.
Output exactly ONE complete figure, one pose, genuine alpha background. No chair, table, floor, shadow, glow, text labels or grid. Strict source edit.

jobs.edit: Change ONLY both pupils and a tiny eyebrow adjustment: look toward SCREEN LEFT at another player. Both pupils must move coherently toward screen-left; never cross-eyed. Keep head orientation front and all body/hands/cards unchanged.
